title: Rung: the Einstein equations as the minimal divergence-compatible closure

statements.text:
Given conserved redistribution, finite propagation, locality, covariance, second-order metric closure and divergence compatibility, the only admissible large-scale geometric completion is $G_{\mu
u} + \Lambda g_{\mu
u} = \kappa_t T_{\mu
u}$.

sources.quote: the admissible large-scale geometric completion is constrained to the Einstein form with a possible cosmological term.
the four-dimensional metric equation is selected in Einstein form with a cosmological term.
